nodes.label: ShadowCube.frag (cube face distance writer)
nodes.rationale: Writes the linear world-space distance from the light to the fragment into an R32_SFLOAT cube face, rather than letting the depth buffer store a projective depth.

nodes.label: Cube stores linear distance, not projective depth
nodes.rationale: A samplerCube lookup has no notion of which face answered, so the stored value must mean the same thing on every face: true for a Euclidean distance, false for a perspective depth that warps differently near a face centre, near its edge, and again on the adjacent face.
